name: Fog Stand
description: Plant a column of fog at the user's side that takes the first blow meant for the user.

name: Pale Reach
description: Reach through the standing fog and feel the shape and pace of everything that moves in it.

name: Mist Lunge
description: Lunge out of the fog with a blow that seems to come from everywhere at once.

name: Fog Footing
description: Give an ally sure footing in the fog so that the ally moves as swiftly as the user does.

name: Fog Bind
description: Thicken the fog about a foe until it holds the foe's limbs like wet wool.

name: Fog Dart
description: Condense the fog into a hard cold dart and loose it at one foe.

name: Standing Domain
description: Set a standing fog over a wide ground that tires every foe within it and shields every friend.

name: Fog Crush
description: Collapse the standing fog inward on everyone inside it in a single cold crushing weight.

name: Edge Dissolve
description: Dissolve the user's edges into the mist so that a foe cannot tell skin from air.

name: Inside Out
description: Turn the mist inside out so that the user appears where the foe thought the outside lay.

name: Boundary Blur
description: Blur the line of the body at the moment of a blow so that the blow finds no line to strike.

name: Contour Feel
description: Feel the borders of every solid thing in reach through the mist that touches them.

name: Aura Smear
description: Smear a foe's aura into the mist so that the foe's qi cannot be placed or aimed.

name: Crack Slip
description: Slip through a seam in a barrier by letting the body go to mist for one breath.

name: Blur Ease
description: Dissolve a binding or a taint on one ally the way mist dissolves a hard line.

name: Edge Unmoor
description: Cut a foe's qi loose from the foe's own technique so that the technique falls apart in mid air.

name: Dissolved Strike
description: Let the blow dissolve into mist and reform inside the foe's guard to strike the body.

name: Paired Haze
description: Set two pale hazes about an ally so that the ally is doubly hard to place.

name: Dual Haze
description: Throw two hazes from left and right so that a foe does not know which side to guard.

name: Mist Pair
description: Step between two banks of mist and come out of the other bank a pace further on.

name: Twin Screen
description: Hold twin screens of mist before and behind the body to blunt blows from both sides.

name: Twin Drift
description: Drift on two banks at once and arrive from two directions as one body.

name: Dew Pair
description: Lay two drops of cleansing dew on an ally to draw out a poison and a fever together.

name: Paired Pall
description: Lay twin banks of foul pall about a foe so that the air itself becomes a slow poison.

name: Twin Close
description: Close both banks together on one foe until the foe is held fast between them.

name: Fog Rise
description: Let fog rise in a basin about the user and fill the user with its cool strength.

name: Drawing Haze
description: Send a river of haze past a foe's eyes so that the foe's aim follows it away.

name: Sunk Veil
description: Sink into the pooled fog so that only the faintest shape of the user remains.

name: Run Mist
description: Run on the flowing mist like a boat on a swift river and cover ground in silence.

name: Fog Flood
description: Let the pooled fog spill out in a cold flood that sweeps every foe off their feet.

name: Mist Drift
description: Drift along the bank of the running mist to a point behind the foe.

name: Gathered Dew
description: Gather clean dew from the pooled fog and let it fall on an ally to wash away a lingering curse.

name: Overflow Fog
description: Set a basin of fog that overflows in slow rings whenever a foe steps near its rim.

name: Mist Pall
description: Let the river of mist spread into a pall that presses down on every foe in it until they slow.

name: Fog Oath
description: Swear the fog to an ally so that the ally is hidden by it and the fog is bound to that ally.

name: Sworn Haze
description: Hold a sworn haze about the body that does not thin however hard the blows fall.

name: Bearing Mist
description: Take a bearing on each living thing by how it parts the mist.

name: Oath Slip
description: Slip a long pace through the fog by trust in the oath that guides the step.

name: Hold Haze
description: Hold a foe in the haze by the weight of the oath laid upon it.

name: Oath Dew
description: Wash the sickness of a broken promise out of an ally with sworn dew.

name: Vowed Fog
description: Set a vowed fog over the ground that lets oath-keepers pass and turns every oath-breaker around.

name: Binding Pall
description: Lay a binding pall over a foe that seals the foe's techniques while the foe stands in it.

name: Open Haze
description: Let the haze spread in every direction and feel whatever stirs within it.

name: Free Drift
description: Drift on the open haze without a fixed course and leave no trail to follow.

name: Haze Brace
description: Brace against a hard blow by spreading the haze thin to take it over a wide area.

name: Wide Fade
description: Fade a whole group of allies into the open haze so that watchers lose count of them.

name: Haze Spread
description: Spread the haze across a wide ground so that foes in it chase shapes that are not there.

name: Unwalled Slip
description: Slip out of a closing ring of foes along the one gap the haze keeps open.

name: Haze Wash
description: Wash an ally in clean haze to draw out poison and the grey sickness of a curse.

name: Boundless Haze
description: Spread a haze with no edge across the land so that foes cannot find where it ends.

name: Haze Sever
description: Cut the thread between a foe and the foe's allies so that each fights alone in the haze.
